citation.authors: Atawodi SE, Mende P, Pfundstein B, Preussmann R et al

cited_by.title: Kola nut: caffeine, the heart and health claims

record.population: Kola nut samples of Nigerian origin (Cola acuminata, C. nitida, Garcinia cola)
record.design: Laboratory analysis of amines and methylating potential after nitrosation
record.finding: Primary and secondary amines were found in all varieties. Methylating activity after nitrosation was higher in kola nuts than ever reported for a fresh plant product, which the authors say suggests the possible role of kola nut chewing in human cancer causes should be explored in countries where it is widely used.
record.note: A chemistry finding that raises a question; no human cancer study was found or is claimed.
